CSV.d: Comma-separated values: a plain-text table with one row per line and columns separated by commas. Test tools often export results this way.

Code execution.d: A Claude capability that lets it write and run code (usually Python) in a private sandbox, to analyse files and create documents such as Excel or Word files.

Project knowledge.d: The documents, text and code added to a Claude project, available to every chat in that project.

Project instructions.d: Standing guidance attached to a Claude project that shapes every chat in it, much like a system prompt.

Persistent storage.d: The ability of an artifact to save data (text only) between visits, either privately per user or shared with everyone who uses it.
